info.name: Get all Charge Capture Claim Creations

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of entities per page, defaults to 100.

params.name: sort
params.description: Defaults to created_at

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Sort direction. Defaults to descending order if not provided.

params.name: patient_external_id
params.description: The patient ID from the external EMR platform for the patient

params.name: claim_creation_status
params.description: the status of the charge capture Claim Creation, refers to whether it was able to create a claim.

params.name: charge_status
params.description: the status of the charge captures

params.name: charge_external_id
date_of_service_min
params.description:
Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD; eg: 2019-08-24.
This date must be the local date in the timezone where the service occurred.

params.name: date_of_service_max
params.description:
Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD; eg: 2019-08-24.
This date must be the local date in the timezone where the service occurred.

params.name: claim_ids
params.description: A list of claim IDs to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations that have a resulting claim with one of the IDs in this list.

params.name: claim_creation_ids
params.description: A list of Claim Creation IDs to filter by.

params.name: billing_provider_npis
params.description: A list of billing provider NPIs to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the NPIs in this list.

params.name: service_facility_name
params.description: A string to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with this service facility name.

params.name: primary_payer_ids
params.description: A list of primary payer IDs to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the primary payer IDs in this list.

params.name: rendering_provider_npis
params.description: A list of rendering provider NPIs to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the NPIs in this list.

params.name: rendering_provider_names
params.description: A list of rendering provider names to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the names in this list.

params.name: supervising_provider_npis
params.description: A list of supervising provider NPIs to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the NPIs in this list.

params.name: supervising_provider_names
params.description: A list of supervising provider names to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the names in this list.

params.name: claim_status
params.description: the status of the claim to filter by created from charge capture bundle.

params.name: claim_creation_category
params.description: A list of claim creation categories to filter by. This will return all charge capture claim_creations which include one or more charges with one of the names in this list.

params.name: tags
params.description: A list of tags to filter by. This will return all charge captures with one of the tags.

params.name: primary_payer_names
params.description: A list of primary payer names to filter by. This will return all charge captures with one of the names.

params.name: patient_names
params.description: A list of patient names to filter by. This will return all charge captures with one of the names.

params.name: has_charge_capture_updates
params.description: If true, only return claim_creations that have charge captures that have been updated since the Claim Creation has had a status of BILLED. See the updates property on ChargeCapture for more details.
